justification: SELINA: Same lineup as last week because it's already correct — I put the highest projected name in every single slot and led this league in scoring, and geniuses don't fix what isn't broken just because Kris Jenner wants a new headline about a running back. Etienne's "Questionable" tag doesn't scare me; I don't bench production because a trainer's report has feelings, and Allgeier can keep marinating on my bench where his $114 price tag can think about what it did. GARY: For the record, I flagged that Etienne's a Thursday-morning "Questionable" and his real game isn't until Sunday anyway, so nothing here is locking early — I just reconfirmed the same nine names she already approved last week, quietly, before she could ask why I was still awake doing it.
